faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Answers to typical questions – short and understandable.

items.a: For everyone who learns or shares knowledge — alone, with a trainer, or with a whole team.

items.q: How do I learn with plinyoo?
items.a: You read a card, answer questions on it and follow the links to the next one. What sticks comes back later, what wobbles comes back sooner.

items.q: Can I bring my own content?
items.a: Yes. You write and link your own cards, have questions generated for them and pull in content from Wikipedia or a shared page.

items.q: In which languages can I learn?
items.a: The interface comes in seven languages. You set two: your native language and the one you are learning right now.
